title: Bounded contexts
situation: One design spanning several subjects let words drift between meanings. A consumer such as cinematiclab has its own subjects (a platform, and each film's production), and one architect may need to hold several of them.
decision: Every concept belongs to exactly one bounded context. Cratylus's own contexts are workflow, delivery and corpus. A cut lies within one context; intent spanning contexts becomes one cut per context, joined by contract examples the consuming context writes. One architect may hold several contexts, but never merges their models. The workflow is context-agnostic: consumers bring their own contexts.
consequences: Recorded as `bounded context`, `context map`, `contract` and `cut` in `design/workflow.md`.
